known_limits: The existing vLLM endpoint is shared; absence of background requests was sampled but an exclusive window was not proven.
T1 uses the buffering benchmark adapter, so its SSE TTFT is not native TTFT; T2/T3 OpenCode JSON events do not expose token-level TTFT or ITL.
T3-T1 includes OpenCode control, a second model round, longer prompt prefill, broker/MCP/Runtime/retrieval, and cannot be labeled pure service overhead.
CPU/RSS is not isolated from co-resident host workloads; GPU telemetry is device-level characterization.
This run cannot authorize test or override the frozen BELOW_TARGET quality decision.

tier_definitions.T0: raw local vLLM OpenAI-compatible streaming endpoint
tier_definitions.T1: OpenWorker Gateway to benchmark adapter to vLLM; no OpenCode and no memory
tier_definitions.T2: OpenCode/OpenWorker with MiLAi integration configured; Router answer path; no MCP call
tier_definitions.T3: OpenCode/OpenWorker to milai_recall MCP to fresh Runtime, then answer
